canonical_hash.description: Hash of canonical little-endian float64 X and int8 y, including array shapes, with NaN payloads and signed zero normalized.

synthetic_historical.description: A reproducible version of the repository's historical synthetic experiment. Normal observations follow a standard Gaussian distribution; anomalies are split between Gamma and Exponential distributions. Rows are shuffled after generation.

target_mapping.description: Pathologic fetal state (NSP=3) is mapped to anomaly; normal and suspect states are mapped to normal for this benchmark proxy.

uci_cardiotocography.proxy_boundary: Cardiotocography is a supervised clinical classification dataset, not native anomaly-detection ground truth. This proxy tests score separation under the declared label mapping and must not be generalized to clinical deployment.

target_mapping.description: Manufacturing fail (1) is mapped to anomaly and pass (-1) to normal.

uci_secom.proxy_boundary: SECOM is a supervised manufacturing pass/fail dataset. A failed unit is a useful rare-event proxy, but it is not proof that every failure is a point anomaly or that the mapping transfers to another process.

target_mapping.description: Bad radar returns (b) are mapped to anomaly and good returns (g) to normal.

uci_ionosphere.proxy_boundary: Ionosphere is a binary radar-return classification dataset and has a comparatively large proxy anomaly class. It is included as a stress case, not as evidence that anomalies are universally rare or share this data geometry.
